sentences.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تُسَاعِدَنِي فِي حَمْلِ هَذِهِ الْحَقِيبَةِ الثَّقِيلَةِ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal yumkinuka an tusaa3idanee fee 7amli haadhihi al-7aqeebati ath-thaqeela?

sentences.arabic: نَظِّفِ الطَّاوِلَةَ وَاكْنُسِ الْأَرْضَ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: nazzifi at-taawilata waknusi al-arda, min fadlik

sentences.arabic: صُبَّ الشَّايَ وَامْلَأْ كُوبِي، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: subba ash-shaaya wamla2 koobee, min fadlik

sentences.arabic: الْأَطْفَالُ يَرْكُضُونَ وَيَقْفِزُونَ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ
sentences.transliteration: al-atfaalu yarkudoona wa yaqfizoona fee al-7adeeqa

sentences.arabic: تَعَالَ شُمَّ الطَّعَامَ، ثُمَّ ذُقْهُ
sentences.transliteration: ta3aala shumma at-ta3aama, thumma dhuqh

sentences.arabic: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلَى الْمُعَلِّمِ وَلَا تَصْرُخْ
sentences.transliteration: istami3 ilaa al-mu3allimi wa laa tasrukh

sentences.arabic: أَدْرُسُ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ بَعْدَ الْعَمَلِ
sentences.transliteration: adrusu al-3arabiyyata kulla masaa2in ba3da al-3amal

sentences.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَشْرَحَ هَذَا الدَّرْسَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal yumkinuka an tashra7a haadhaa ad-darsa marratan ukhraa, min fadlik?

sentences.arabic: اِحْفَظِ الْمَلَفَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُغْلِقَ الْحَاسُوبَ
sentences.transliteration: i7fazi al-malaffa qabla an tughliqa al-7aasoob

sentences.arabic: تَرْجَمَتْ لِي الرِّسَالَةَ إِلَى الْإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ
sentences.transliteration: tarjamat lee ar-risaalata ilaa al-injileeziyya

sentences.arabic: وَقِّعْ هُنَا وَسَلِّمِ الْأَوْرَاقَ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: waqqi3 hunaa wa sallimi al-awraaqa, min fadlik

sentences.arabic: هَلْ تَتَذَكَّرُ أَيْنَ وَضَعْتُ الْأَوْرَاقَ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal tatadhakkaru ayna wada3tu al-awraaq?

sentences.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَجِيءَ غَدًا وَتُصْلِحَ الْبَابَ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal yumkinuka an tajee2a ghadan wa tusli7a al-baab?

sentences.arabic: أَظْهِرْ لِي كَيْفَ أَسْتَخْدِمُ هَذِهِ الْآلَةَ
sentences.transliteration: azhir lee kayfa astakhdimu haadhihi al-aala

sentences.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تُعِيرَنِي قَلَمَكَ لَحْظَةً؟
sentences.transliteration: hal yumkinuka an tu3eeranee qalamaka la7za?

sentences.arabic: لَا تَنْسَ أَنْ تُقْفِلَ الْبَابَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
sentences.transliteration: laa tansa an tuqfila al-baaba fee al-layl

sentences.arabic: أَبِي يَغْرِسُ الْأَشْجَارَ وَيَسْقِيهَا كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ
sentences.transliteration: abee yaghrisu al-ashjaara wa yasqeehaa kulla sabaa7

sentences.arabic: بَدَؤُوا يَبْنُونَ بَيْتًا جَدِيدًا السَّنَةَ الْمَاضِيَةَ
sentences.transliteration: bada2oo yabnoona baytan jadeedan as-sanata al-maadiya

sentences.arabic: أَشْعُرُ بِالتَّعَبِ الْيَوْمَ، لِذَلِكَ سَأَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ
sentences.transliteration: ash3uru bit-ta3abi al-yawma, lidhaalika sa2abqaa fee al-bayt

sentences.arabic: أُحِبُّ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَحْتَرِمُهُمَا كَثِيرًا
sentences.transliteration: u7ibbu waalidayya wa a7tarimuhumaa katheeraa

sentences.arabic: لَا تَقْلَقْ، كُلُّ شَيْءٍ سَيَكُونُ بِخَيْرٍ
sentences.transliteration: laa taqlaq, kullu shay2in sayakoonu bikhayr

sentences.arabic: أَنَا أَثِقُ بِكَ، فَلَا تَكْذِبْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: anaa athiqu bika, fa laa takdhib 3alayya min fadlik

sentences.arabic: وَعَدَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ، لَكِنْ يَبْدُو أَنَّهُ مَشْغُولٌ
sentences.transliteration: wa3ada an ya2tiya, laakin yabdoo annahu mashghool

sentences.arabic: عَانَقَتْ جَدَّتَهَا وَهَنَّأَتْهَا بِالْعِيدِ
sentences.transliteration: 3aanaqat jaddatahaa wa hanna2at-haa bil-3eed
